svg.aria-label: One image embedding is multiplied with a right and a wrong sentence embedding. The difference of the two scores depends only on the difference of the two sentence vectors.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: The score difference only sees where the two sentences differ
a cat to the left of a dog
a dog to the left of a cat
T right minus T wrong is the dashed line
Sketch in 2 dimensions: the real vectors have 768 numbers.
If the two sentences get the same vector, the difference is 0 everywhere.
